### Lecture 1 (09:00-10:30): Network medicine tools for data-driven health (Speaker: Mika Gustafsson)
The lecture introduces network models, such as deep neural network, and the applications in AI-based precision medicine.

## Break (10:30-10:45)

### Lecture 2 (10:45-12:00): Generative AI for Omics analysis (Speaker: Wen Zhong)

The lecture focuses on an introduction to machine learning methods, and generative AI (e.g. Transformer) and their application in biomedical research.

 
## Lunch break (12:00-13:00)

### Workshop 1 (13:00-14:00): Classical ML methods (Workshop instructor: Xingyue Wang)
The workshop aims to understand the general modeling problem and the basic pipeline in model training and testing.


### Workshop 2 (14:00-16:00): Generative AI models for omics analysis (Workshop instructor: Xingyu Qiao)
The workshop aims to illustrate the application of pre-trained generative AI models for the classification of cell types and identification of cell markers.
